from pyspark.sql import functions as F

GOLD_PATH = (
    "abfss://gold@stnvdaanna2026.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweets_stock/historical/"
)

df = spark.read.parquet(GOLD_PATH)

training_df = (
    df
    .filter(F.col("next_available_volume").isNotNull())
)

print("Total Gold rows:", df.count())
print("Training-ready rows:", training_df.count())

training_df.select(
    F.countDistinct("prediction_session_date").alias("training_sessions"),
    F.min("prediction_session_date").alias("min_session"),
    F.max("prediction_session_date").alias("max_session"),
    F.min("next_available_volume").alias("min_target"),
    F.max("next_available_volume").alias("max_target")
).show()

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

# Get ordered labeled trading sessions
sessions = [
    row["prediction_session_date"]
    for row in (
        training_df
        .select("prediction_session_date")
        .distinct()
        .orderBy("prediction_session_date")
        .collect()
    )
]

split_idx = int(len(sessions) * 0.8)

train_sessions = sessions[:split_idx]
test_sessions = sessions[split_idx:]

print("Total sessions:", len(sessions))
print("Train sessions:", len(train_sessions))
print("Test sessions:", len(test_sessions))

print("\nTrain:")
print(train_sessions)

print("\nTest:")
print(test_sessions)

train_df = training_df.filter(
    F.col("prediction_session_date").isin(train_sessions)
)

test_df = training_df.filter(
    F.col("prediction_session_date").isin(test_sessions)
)

print("\nTrain rows:", train_df.count())
print("Test rows:", test_df.count())

numeric_features = [
    "sentiment_score",
    "interaction_score",
    "favorite_ratio",
    "reply_ratio",
    "followers_count",
    "friends_count",
    "media_count",
    "account_age_days",
    "credibility_score"
]

boolean_features = [
    "is_viral",
    "is_blue_verified",
    "is_new_account",
    "is_influencer",
    "is_weekend"
]

categorical_features = [
    "day_of_week"
]

label_col = "next_available_volume"

from pyspark.ml import Pipeline
from pyspark.ml.feature import (
    StringIndexer,
    OneHotEncoder,
    VectorAssembler,
    StandardScaler
)
from pyspark.ml.regression import RandomForestRegressor
from pyspark.ml.evaluation import RegressionEvaluator

day_indexer = StringIndexer(
    inputCol="day_of_week",
    outputCol="day_of_week_index",
    handleInvalid="keep"
)

day_encoder = OneHotEncoder(
    inputCol="day_of_week_index",
    outputCol="day_of_week_ohe",
    handleInvalid="keep"

assembler_inputs = (
    numeric_features
    + boolean_features
    + ["day_of_week_ohe"]
)

assembler = VectorAssembler(
    inputCols=assembler_inputs,
    outputCol="raw_features",
    handleInvalid="keep"

scaler = StandardScaler(
    inputCol="raw_features",
    outputCol="features",
    withStd=True,
    withMean=False

rf = RandomForestRegressor(
    featuresCol="features",
    labelCol=label_col,
    predictionCol="prediction",
    seed=42

pipeline = Pipeline(
    stages=[
        day_indexer,
        day_encoder,
        assembler,
        scaler,
        rf
    ]
)

print("ML pipeline ready.")

baseline_model = pipeline.fit(train_ml)

predictions = baseline_model.transform(test_ml)

predictions.select(
    "tweet_id",
    "prediction_session_date",
    "next_available_volume",
    "prediction"
).show(20, truncate=False)

rmse_evaluator = RegressionEvaluator(
    labelCol="next_available_volume",
    predictionCol="prediction",
    metricName="rmse"
)

mae_evaluator = RegressionEvaluator(
    labelCol="next_available_volume",
    predictionCol="prediction",
    metricName="mae"
)

r2_evaluator = RegressionEvaluator(
    labelCol="next_available_volume",
    predictionCol="prediction",
    metricName="r2"
)

rmse = rmse_evaluator.evaluate(predictions)
mae = mae_evaluator.evaluate(predictions)
r2 = r2_evaluator.evaluate(predictions)

print(f"Tweet-level RMSE: {rmse:,.2f}")
print(f"Tweet-level MAE : {mae:,.2f}")
print(f"Tweet-level R²  : {r2:.4f}")

session_predictions = (
    predictions
    .groupBy("prediction_session_date")
    .agg(
        F.first("next_available_volume").alias("actual_volume"),
        F.avg("prediction").alias("predicted_volume"),
        F.count("*").alias("tweet_count")
    )
    .orderBy("prediction_session_date")
)

session_predictions.show(truncate=False)

session_eval_df = (
    session_predictions
    .withColumnRenamed("actual_volume", "label")
    .withColumnRenamed("predicted_volume", "prediction")
)

session_rmse = RegressionEvaluator(
    labelCol="label",
    predictionCol="prediction",
    metricName="rmse"
).evaluate(session_eval_df)

session_mae = RegressionEvaluator(
    labelCol="label",
    predictionCol="prediction",
    metricName="mae"
).evaluate(session_eval_df)

session_r2 = RegressionEvaluator(
    labelCol="label",
    predictionCol="prediction",
    metricName="r2"
).evaluate(session_eval_df)

print(f"Session-level RMSE: {session_rmse:,.2f}")
print(f"Session-level MAE : {session_mae:,.2f}")
print(f"Session-level R²  : {session_r2:.4f}")

from itertools import product

param_grid = [
    {
        "numTrees": num_trees,
        "maxDepth": max_depth,
        "minInstancesPerNode": min_instances
    }
    for num_trees, max_depth, min_instances
    in product(
        [50, 100],
        [5, 10],
        [1, 5]
    )
]

print("Parameter combinations:", len(param_grid))

for p in param_grid:
    print(p)

ordered_train_sessions = sorted(train_sessions)

n = len(ordered_train_sessions)

folds = [
    (
        ordered_train_sessions[:10],
        ordered_train_sessions[10:12]
    ),
    (
        ordered_train_sessions[:12],
        ordered_train_sessions[12:14]
    ),
    (
        ordered_train_sessions[:14],
        ordered_train_sessions[14:16]
    )
]

for i, (train_s, val_s) in enumerate(folds, 1):
    print(f"\nFold {i}")
    print("Train:", train_s[0], "→", train_s[-1])
    print("Validation:", val_s)

from pyspark.ml import Pipeline
from pyspark.ml.regression import RandomForestRegressor
from pyspark.ml.evaluation import RegressionEvaluator

def build_pipeline(params):

    rf_model = RandomForestRegressor(
        featuresCol="features",
        labelCol="next_available_volume",
        predictionCol="prediction",

        numTrees=params["numTrees"],
        maxDepth=params["maxDepth"],
        minInstancesPerNode=params["minInstancesPerNode"],

        seed=42
    )

    return Pipeline(
        stages=[
            day_indexer,
            day_encoder,
            assembler,
            scaler,
            rf_model
        ]
    )


def session_mae_from_predictions(pred_df):

    session_df = (
        pred_df
        .groupBy("prediction_session_date")
        .agg(
            F.first("next_available_volume").alias("label"),
            F.avg("prediction").alias("prediction")
        )
    )

    evaluator = RegressionEvaluator(
        labelCol="label",
        predictionCol="prediction",
        metricName="mae"
    )

    return evaluator.evaluate(session_df)

results = []

for params in param_grid:

    fold_maes = []

    print("\nTesting:", params)

    for fold_number, (fold_train_sessions, fold_val_sessions) in enumerate(folds, 1):

        fold_train = (
            training_df
            .filter(
                F.col("prediction_session_date")
                .isin(fold_train_sessions)
            )
        )

        fold_val = (
            training_df
            .filter(
                F.col("prediction_session_date")
                .isin(fold_val_sessions)
            )
        )

        fold_train = prepare_ml_columns(fold_train)
        fold_val = prepare_ml_columns(fold_val)

        model = build_pipeline(params).fit(fold_train)

        fold_predictions = model.transform(fold_val)

        mae = session_mae_from_predictions(
            fold_predictions
        )

        fold_maes.append(mae)

        print(
            f"  Fold {fold_number} MAE: "
            f"{mae:,.2f}"
        )

    avg_mae = sum(fold_maes) / len(fold_maes)

    results.append({
        **params,
        "fold_maes": fold_maes,
        "avg_mae": avg_mae
    })

    print(
        f"  Average MAE: {avg_mae:,.2f}"

results_sorted = sorted(
    results,
    key=lambda x: x["avg_mae"]
)

print("===== TUNING RESULTS =====")

for r in results_sorted:

    print(
        f"trees={r['numTrees']:3d} | "
        f"depth={r['maxDepth']:2d} | "
        f"minInstances={r['minInstancesPerNode']} | "
        f"MAE={r['avg_mae']:,.2f}"
    )


best_params = results_sorted[0]

print("\n===== BEST PARAMETERS =====")
print(best_params)

best_rf_params = {
    "numTrees": 50,
    "maxDepth": 5,
    "minInstancesPerNode": 5
}

final_pipeline = build_pipeline(best_rf_params)

final_model = final_pipeline.fit(train_ml)

print("Final model trained.")

final_predictions = final_model.transform(test_ml)

final_session_predictions = (
    final_predictions
    .groupBy("prediction_session_date")
    .agg(
        F.first("next_available_volume").alias("actual_volume"),
        F.avg("prediction").alias("predicted_volume"),
        F.count("*").alias("tweet_count")
    )
    .orderBy("prediction_session_date")
)

final_session_predictions.show(
    truncate=False

final_eval = (
    final_session_predictions
    .withColumnRenamed("actual_volume", "label")
    .withColumnRenamed("predicted_volume", "prediction")
)

final_rmse = RegressionEvaluator(
    labelCol="label",
    predictionCol="prediction",
    metricName="rmse"
).evaluate(final_eval)

final_mae = RegressionEvaluator(
    labelCol="label",
    predictionCol="prediction",
    metricName="mae"
).evaluate(final_eval)

final_r2 = RegressionEvaluator(
    labelCol="label",
    predictionCol="prediction",
    metricName="r2"
).evaluate(final_eval)

print("===== FINAL TEST RESULTS =====")
print(f"RMSE: {final_rmse:,.2f}")
print(f"MAE : {final_mae:,.2f}")
print(f"R²  : {final_r2:.4f}")

final_session_predictions = (
    final_session_predictions

    .withColumn(
        "absolute_error",
        F.abs(
            F.col("actual_volume")
            - F.col("predicted_volume")
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "relative_error",
        F.col("absolute_error")
        / F.col("actual_volume")
    )

    .withColumn(
        "accuracy",
        F.lit(1.0)
        - F.col("relative_error")
    )
)

final_session_predictions.select(
    "prediction_session_date",
    "actual_volume",
    "predicted_volume",
    "absolute_error",
    "relative_error",
    "accuracy"
).show(truncate=False)

all_labeled_ml = prepare_ml_columns(
    training_df
)

deployment_pipeline = build_pipeline(
    best_rf_params
)

deployment_model = deployment_pipeline.fit(
    all_labeled_ml
)

print(
    "Deployment model trained on rows:",
    all_labeled_ml.count()
)

print(
    "Deployment training sessions:",
    all_labeled_ml
    .select("prediction_session_date")
    .distinct()
    .count()

MODEL_PATH = (
    "abfss://gold@stnvdaanna2026.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "models/nvda_volume_rf/"
)

deployment_model.write().overwrite().save(
    MODEL_PATH
)

print("Model saved:")
print(MODEL_PATH)

from pyspark.ml import PipelineModel

loaded_model = PipelineModel.load(
    MODEL_PATH
)

print("Model loaded successfully.")

reload_predictions = (
    loaded_model

reload_session_predictions = (
    reload_predictions

        F.first(

        ).alias("actual_volume"),

        F.avg(
            "prediction"

        F.count("*").alias("tweet_count")
    )
    .orderBy("prediction_session_date")

reload_session_predictions.show(
    truncate=False

MODEL_FEATURES = (
    numeric_features
    + boolean_features
    + categorical_features
)

for x in numeric_features:
